notes: Level vocabulary: the brief suggested 'MPharm Year 1'-'MPharm Year 4', but every existing pharmacy LV line (u04, u05: 43 lines) uses 'Intermediate · <difficulty>'. As instructed, I followed the course's existing convention and used 'Intermediate' for all 44 lessons. If the coordinator moves the course to MPharm years, my judgement is: u02 lessons 01-19 MPharm Year 1-2, u02 20-24 MPharm Year 2-3; u06 01-11 MPharm Year 1, u06 12-19 MPharm Year 2-3, u06-20 Foundation training.
LV lines are placed after the O: lines (as ASSESS.md says); u04/u05 put them after the ## title. The parser accepts either.

New sources added only where a lesson had one: The Concise Guide to Pharmacology 2023/24 (already cited in u02-03), Neubig et al. 2003 Pharmacological Reviews 55:597-606 (IUPHAR terms in quantitative pharmacology), the BNF, Rang and Dale 10th edition, the NPSA 2007 oral syringe alert, the Medusa Injectable Medicines Guide and the British Pharmacopoeia, all already cited elsewhere in the course except Neubig 2003.
